summary: Iter45: Verified new PATCH /api/bank-analysis/category-overrides/{desc_key} endpoint and inline <select> dropdown on the Regras IA tab. Backend (6/6 PASS): valid category returns {ok:true,category:'obra'} and persists via GET list; invalid category → 400; missing category → 400; nonexistent desc_key → 404; endpoint requires auth. Frontend (Playwright, all PASS): admin login → /definicoes → Regras IA tab renders 3 rows (vodafone/joteilux/sonepar) each with data-testid='cat-select-{desc_key}' <select> instead of a static pill. Changed vodafone from 'fixo' to 'variavel' → optimistic UI update (pill turned orange 'Custo Variável'), toast 'Regra atualizada → Custo Variável' appeared, and after full page reload the change was persisted. Value restored to 'fixo' after test to avoid polluting seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH endpoint correctly validates category against the same whitelist used elsewhere (fixo/variavel/obra/receita/imposto/salario/financeiro/outro) — consistent with cat_to_type map in approve_sync.
Frontend uses encodeURIComponent(descKey) both for DELETE and PATCH — safe for keys with spaces/unicode.
Optimistic UI update via setOverrides map is fine; on API failure the local state won't be rolled back to the previous value. Minor: consider reverting on catch. Not blocking (toast.error is shown).
The dropdown appearance-none + inline background/color style works but the native select still uses OS-styled option list on open — cosmetic, not a bug.
PATCH endpoint uses JSON body for category (unlike the transaction-learning PATCH which uses a query param). Slight inconsistency across the bank_analysis router, but acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (dropdown, PATCH call, toast, optimistic update, persistence all verified)

seed_data_creation: None. Used the 3 pre-seeded overrides (joteilux, vodafone, sonepar). Vodafone was toggled to 'variavel' during the UI test and restored to 'fixo' at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PATCH /api/bank-analysis/category-overrides/{desc_key} is fully working. Frontend inline <select> on Regras IA tab (data-testid='cat-select-{desc_key}') is functional with toast + optimistic update + backend persistence. Seed overrides preserved.
